title: Streamlining Cardano DApp Development with Open-Source Batcher

ms.promise:
・Comprehensive design document detailing the architecture of the reference batcher.
・Selection of tools and libraries to be used in development.
ms.criteria:
・Approval of design document by the project technical lead.
・Finalization of tools and libraries as documented in the project repository.
ms.report:
Dear Reviewers, 
under the following links you can find the required evidence
・Uploaded technical design document to GitHub: https://github.com/LinkageDevTeam/cardano-batcher-template/blob/main/technical-report.pdf
・List of selected tools and libraries: A summary of the list of selected tools can be found in our README file: (section Tools & Libraries: https://github.com/LinkageDevTeam/cardano-batcher-template). Moreover, we included a section 4 in the report with a short explanation

Update: In the previous submission of the Milestone we had a report with some [??] in some of the sections. This was due to wrong citation settings in our latex export. I am super sorry about this mistake and we fixed this now.

ms.promise:
・Functional core of the reference batcher enabling transaction batching (core means being able to identify open batching requests on chain and constructing the necessary batching transactions)
・Initial test suite for core functionalities.
ms.criteria:
・Functionality meets design specifications and transactions can be batched
・Transaction showing that all initial tests (identify batching requests, batch order) have been passed
ms.report:
Dear Reviewers, 
please find our milestone outputs below. 
Update: We also included the GNU license in our repository. Thank you for the feedback :) 
A. Output: Functional core of the reference batcher enabling transaction batching (core means being able to identify open batching requests on chain and constructing the necessary batching transactions)
Acceptance criteria: Functionality meets design specifications and transactions can be batched
Evidence: Please check our Github repository with the necessary code and a README explaining all functionalities: https://github.com/LinkageDevTeam/cardano-batcher-template

B. Output: Initial test suite for core functionalities.
Acceptance criteria: Transaction showing that all initial tests (identify batching requests, batch order) have been passed
Evidence: Test transactions documented and published in the project repository.
The test transactions are linked in the README file: https://github.com/LinkageDevTeam/cardano-batcher-template/blob/main/README.md. We have created a test-suite that is testing different components and functionalities (like datum parsing, or batching ordering).
